sources.snippet: Qwen2.5 is the latest series of Qwen large language models. For Qwen2.5, we release a number of base language models and instruction-tuned language models ranging from 0.5 to 72 billion parameters.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct is an instruction-tuned causal language model built by Qwen containing 0.49 billion parameters (0.36 billion non-embedding). This model uses a transformer architecture with RoPE positional embeddings, SwiGLU activation, RMSNorm, attention QKV bias, and tied word embeddings. It supports a full context length of 32,768 tokens and can generate up to 8,192 tokens ...
